title: Swept Sine
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Swept_Sine.md
text: Generate commands to conduct swept sine maneuver, 1 input, 2 outputs; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} sets the handwheel steer amplitude, {Final frequency, steerFinalFreq [Hz]} sets the hold time after maximum steer amplitude, {Swept time, tSweep [s]} sets the duration of sweep procedure and {Initial steer direction}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Final frequency, steerFinalFreq [Hz]
params.values: Hold time after maximum steer amplitude reached 0.7 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Swept time, tSweep [s]
params.values: Duration of sweep procedure 30 (default) | positive scalar
